correction: These body-XOR cases are expected-success controls. Keep all prior selectors and physical-preservation requirements; distinguish a reported source-body change from a real file mutation. Other selected source consumers retain their own content-rejection expectations, which still require actual execution evidence.
finding: The prior blanket body-XOR rejection expectation is incorrect for structure-only census reads.
incorrect_clause: Reader and source return; the original consumer must reject altered content
mechanism: The structural census obtains a source, checks descriptor/named metadata and closes it. Its result contains only image/reference names. It does not inspect, retain or return source bytes. The lower reader checks length and physical metadata; source admission checks size, mode, link count and descriptor inheritance. A same-length modeled buffer change with unchanged physical bytes therefore passes this structural path. Later semantic reads receive the unchanged physical bytes because the control affects only one source occurrence.
qualification_limit: Static source applicability and historical healthy-flow projection only. No new release fixture, injected read, native process or original producer has run.
